name: levels/level-1-multi-defect-domain-and-version
description: Check-order fixture with two defects: the DNS TXT record was published at _a2a-identity.example.net while provider.url is https://example.com (a DOMAIN_MISMATCH), and the record carries an unsupported version v=a2a9 (a SHAPE_INVALID). The record-name binding check precedes the record-version shape check in the contract order, so a conforming verifier MUST reject with DOMAIN_MISMATCH. A verifier that runs every shape check before any binding check reports SHAPE_INVALID and fails this fixture.

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Level 1 DNS Verification (check order: record name before record version)
